title: Ye maahe moharram hai mazloom ka maatam hai
body:
karti hai buka zahra, kya karb ka aalamm hai
Ye maahe moharram hai mazloom ka maatam hai
1) Utra hai karbala me , yu'n fatima ka kunba
garmi ka hai maheena, aur maahe moharram hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2) apne lahu ki, qushboo, soonghi to shaah bole
Maqtal yahi'n banega, apna yahi'n haran hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Abbas ko bulaao, qaime yahi'n lagaao
asbaab sab utaaro, rukte yahi'n pe hum hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Maidaan-e- karbala me, ab dashte nainawa me
darya-e-alqama pe, abbas ka alam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Is qafele me sheh ke, kam sin hai aur jawaa'n bhi
in naasero me sheh ke , har eik hum qadam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6) pehra hai karbala me , abbase baawafa ka
abbas ki wafa pe, har ek ko bharam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7) ek nafse mutmaee'n ka , wo shaahe inso jin ka
har maatami ke oopar, sheh ka bada karam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Aaye sadaae sarwar, karbobala se hyder
aashor tak hamaare, mehmaan sab haram hai
